title: Molecular basis for anti-jumbo phage immunity by AVAST Type 5
authors: Muralidharan A; Costa AR; Fierlier D; van den Berg DF; van den Bossche H; Zoumaro-Djayoon AD; Pabst M; Pacesa M; Correia BE; Brouns SJJ
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌Avs5系统识别巨型噬菌体蛋白JADA并触发NAD+水解的免疫机制，涉及蛋白-蛋白识别而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Jumbo phages protect their genomes from DNA-sensing bacterial defense systems by enclosing them within vesicles and nucleus-like compartments. Very little is known about defense systems specialized to counter these phages. Here, we show that AVAST Type 5 (Avs5) systems, part of the STAND superfamily and spanning three phylogenetic Avs5 clades, confer conserved immunity against jumbo phages. Using localization microscopy and biotin proximity labeling we demonstrate that Avs5 localizes to early infection vesicles, where it senses an essential, early expressed phage protein named JADA—Jumbophage AVAST5 Defense Activator. Recognition of phage infection triggers the Sir2-like effector domain of Avs5 across all three Avs5 clades, resulting in rapid NAD + hydrolysis, disruption of phage nucleus formation, and arrest of infection. These findings reveal a spatially coordinated bacterial immune strategy that targets an early vulnerability in jumbo phage infection.
abstract_zh: 巨型噬菌体通过将其基因组包裹在囊泡和类核区室中，以保护自身免受细菌基于DNA识别的防御系统的攻击。关于专门针对这些噬菌体的防御系统，目前所知甚少。在此，我们展示了AVAST Type 5（Avs5）系统，作为STAND超家族的一部分，跨越三个系统发育Avs5分支，赋予针对巨型噬菌体的保守免疫。利用定位显微镜和生物素邻近标记技术，我们证明Avs5定位于早期感染囊泡，在此处它识别一种必需的、早期表达的噬菌体蛋白，命名为JADA——巨型噬菌体AVAST5防御激活因子。对噬菌体感染的识别触发Avs5在所有三个Avs5分支中的Sir2样效应域，导致快速的NAD+水解、噬菌体核形成的破坏以及感染的停滞。这些发现揭示了一种空间协调的细菌免疫策略，该策略针对巨型噬菌体感染中的早期脆弱点。
